text: Raschke on BBY: I read a BREAKOUT (C2), D 0.1% under 20-day high, H1 HH/HL at 97% of the day's range. In my canon day_vol is only a range proxy (R5), never a +40% gate; my C16 is index breadth, out of scope (R8). So I cannot confirm oneil's day_vol 1.31 test and do not need it: my trigger stays h1_close_above:bar_high, wrong if close_below:bar_low under the trigger bar (C17). The room may print oneil's test as his dissent; my method gives no reason to set the trigger on it. What would move me: the H1 trigger bar fully retraced.
